description: Source code implementing SSL cipher suite name mappings, SSL version to string conversion, and SSL status evaluation functions for Chromium's network security layer.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatusForProtocol
methods.description: Determines if the SSL protocol version is considered obsolete.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatusForCipherSuite
methods.description: Checks if a cipher suite is considered obsolete based on its value.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatusForSignature
methods.description: Determines if a signature algorithm is considered obsolete.

methods.name: SSLCipherSuiteToStrings
methods.description: Converts a cipher suite value to human-readable strings for key exchange, cipher, and MAC.

methods.name: SSLVersionToString
methods.description: Converts an SSL version number to its string representation.

methods.name: ParseSSLCipherString
methods.description: Parses a hex string to a cipher suite value.

methods.name: ObsoleteSSLStatus
methods.description: Aggregates SSL status flags based on connection status and signature algorithm.

methods.name: IsTLSCipherSuiteAllowedByHTTP2
methods.description: Checks if a cipher suite is allowed by HTTP/2 based on its obsolescence status.
